brand.privacyLine1: Privacy by design. Nothing is shared without your consent.
brand.privacyLine2: CardioGuard is a prevention education tool. It is not a medical device.

numbers.title: Understand your numbers
numbers.body: See how your readings and habits trend over time.

data.title: Your data stays yours
data.body: Encrypted and never sold. Nothing is shared without your consent.

habits.title: Build healthier habits
habits.body: Small, evidence based steps that fit into your day.

notMedical.title: Not a medical device
notMedical.body: Education and prevention only. In an emergency, call your local number.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: CardioGuard could not finish starting up. Check your internet connection and try again. Your information is safe and nothing has been lost.
error.a11yNote: Retry receives focus when the error appears. No health assessment is implied.

step02.title: Welcome to CardioGuard
step02.intro: CardioGuard helps you understand cardiovascular prevention, track your health information, and build healthier daily habits around what you choose to share.
step02.calloutTitle: Not a doctor, and never in an emergency
step02.calloutBody: CardioGuard supports prevention education and habit guidance. It does not diagnose, treat, or replace a healthcare professional. For urgent symptoms, contact emergency services.
step02.privacyNote: Privacy by design. Nothing is shared without your consent.

step03.title: Before we begin
step03.intro: You decide what CardioGuard may know and do. Please read and accept the rules that let us keep you safe.
step03.helper: You must accept both. If you do not agree, no health profile will be created or processed.

statement.notDoctor: I understand CardioGuard is not a doctor, does not provide a diagnosis, and does not replace a healthcare professional.
statement.notEmergency: I understand CardioGuard is not for emergencies and I should contact local emergency services for urgent symptoms.

step03.footnote: Optional permissions such as notifications and health apps are never part of this step. They are offered separately and can be skipped.

error.title: You missed a required decision
error.body: Please choose Accept for both required statements before continuing. Nothing has been saved yet. Screen reader announces the missing one.

age.title: How old are you?
age.intro: Age helps us tailor prevention guidance to your stage of life. It is optional and you can skip it.
age.footnote: Skipping records this as missing. CardioGuard will never guess your age.
age.demoNote: Demo mode. Use fictitious answers. Reloading clears your answers.

actions.unavailable: This step is not available yet. No answer has been saved.

error.title: Could not save the demo answer
error.body: Your selection is still here. Try again, or check that temporary browser storage is allowed.

health.title: Health conditions
health.intro: Select any that apply. Tell us your own understanding. This is user-reported information, not a diagnosis, and is not shared without consent.

medications.title: Medications
medications.body: List any you take for blood pressure, cholesterol, or heart health (optional). Everything here stays user-reported.

health.footnote: Everything here stays user-reported. We never label you with a diagnosis.

lifestyle.title: Activity level
lifestyle.intro: Tell us roughly how active you usually are in a typical week.

goals.title: What do you want to work toward?
goals.intro: Pick as many as you like. This shapes educational guidance only.

height.title: Height
height.label: Height (cm)
height.range: Enter a height between {min} cm and {max} cm.
height.outsideRange: {height, number} cm is outside the expected range.

warning.title: That value looks off
warning.body: Please check the highlighted value. It was not saved or used in any guidance.

height.footnote: If you are describing severe or urgent symptoms, emergency guidance will appear. This is separate from validation.

step06.title: Optional permissions
step06.intro: None of these are required. You can skip every option and change your mind later. Each is explained before you decide.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.description: Get gentle nudges for logging readings and building habits.

location.title: Location
location.description: Not requested. Location is only added if a clear purpose is confirmed.

step06.footnote: Imported health data never fills gaps we do not know.
step06.unavailable: This step is not available yet. No choices have been saved.

error.title: Could not save your demo choices
error.body: Your choices are still here. Try again, or check that temporary browser storage is allowed.

step07.title: Preparing your starting summary
step07.body: Organising what you told us (and what is still missing) into an initial experience for you. No assessment or diagnosis is being made.
step07.status: This usually takes a few seconds.

error.title: We could not finish preparing
error.body: Your answers are safe and were not lost. Retry, or continue to a basic view without the personalised summary.

unavailable.title: Preparation is unavailable
unavailable.missing: Create a demo account to prepare your starting summary.
unavailable.error: The demo account could not be opened. Check that your browser allows temporary storage.

profile.title: Complete your profile
profile.heightWeight: Add height and weight to make education more specific.
profile.weight: Add weight to make education more specific.

habit.title: Start a habit
habit.body: Pick a gentle daily goal like a short walk. General prevention guidance only.

education.title: Browse education
education.body: Read prevention topics grounded in approved sources.

step08.title: Here is your starting point
step08.intro: This reflects what you told us. It is not a diagnosis and not a risk score.
step08.missingBody: Unreported information: {fields}. Guidance that depends on it will say so.

walking.title: Start a walking habit
walking.body: A gentle weekly activity goal is a common starting point. This is general guidance, not a prescription.

step08.footnote: CardioGuard does not provide a risk score or a diagnosis. Educational guidance is based on general prevention principles.

step09.title: Welcome to CardioGuard
step09.intro: Your start here is a launching point, not a verdict. As you add information, education becomes more specific to you.

ready.title: Ready to begin
ready.body: Keep building your profile at your own pace. Nothing blocks core education.

step09.footnote: CardioGuard does not produce a risk score or a diagnosis. Every suggestion is educational and grounded in approved prevention sources.

skipped.title: Your profile is mostly empty
skipped.body: You skipped the optional questions. That is fine. Core education is still available.

error.title: We could not reach the dashboard
error.body: Your onboarding information is safe and was not lost. Retry, and if the problem continues contact support.

register.title: Create your account
register.intro: Create an account to keep your health data safe and synced across devices. Your information is encrypted and never sold.

email.label: Email
email.helper: Used to sign in. Never shared.
email.inUse: This email address is already in use. Try another one.

register.footnote: With an account your progress and health data sync across devices. Guest mode keeps you exploring with limited persistence.

validation.title: Please fix the highlighted fields
validation.body: No account was created yet. Check the messages under each field.

unavailable.account: Account creation is not available yet. Your details have not been sent or saved.
unavailable.guest: Guest mode is not available yet. Your details have not been sent or saved.

register.demoNote: Demo mode: use fictitious details only. No real account is created and no password is sent or saved.

requestError.title: Could not create the demo account
requestError.body: Nothing was created. Your entries are still here. Try again, or check that temporary browser storage is allowed.

notBuilt.title: This screen is not built yet
notBuilt.body: The shell, sidebar and navigation are in place. The screen itself ships in the next slice of this flow.
